entities.name: Ana María Sánchez de Ríos
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ana María Liliana Sánchez Vargas de Ríos is a Peruvian diplomat. She has a degree in law from the Pontifical Catholic University of Peru and a licentiate in International Relations from the Diplomatic Academy of Peru. She was the country's Minister of Foreign Affairs from 2 April 2015 to 28 July 2016.

entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ana María Liliana Sánchez Vargas de Ríos is a Peruvian diplomat. She has a degree in law from the Pontifical Catholic University of Peru and a licentiate in International Relations from the Diplomatic Academy of Peru. She was the country's Minister of Foreign Affairs from 2 April 2015 to 28 July 2016.
